yaml-test-suite reference fixtures
==================================

Source repository:
  https://github.com/yaml/yaml-test-suite
Pinned commit:
  da267a5c4782e7361e82889e76c0dc7df0e1e870
Source directory:
  src/

The local YAML payloads are copied from these pinned test cases:
  2JQS  Duplicate empty mapping keys
  M5DY  Complex sequence keys
  SBG9  Flow sequence as a mapping key
  6BFJ  Anchors on a mapping and complex key
  565N  Explicit binary construction
  EHF6  Explicit map and sequence tags
  SF5V  Duplicate YAML directive (invalid)
  H7TQ  Extra directive words (invalid)
  VJP3  Multi-line flow indentation, invalid and valid variants

  yaml-test-suite-data-2022-01-17.zip

  45db50ae
